notes.title: Small Play Mode Update
notes.content: [p]Sorry for taking so long to update. I have added 2 options for the number of rings and 3 options for the number of cones. You will be able to select them when starting the single player or the pvp modes.[/p][p]The next update should be available within a month, hopefully. I plan to add controller support, enable steam remote play and maybe add support for other platforms.[/p][p][/p][p]If you run into any bugs please post in the community page. Post suggestions too. I will definitely be looking at problems and suggestions.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for checking out the game :)[/p]
